name: Believing
overview: Scripture emphasizes that believing is foundational to experiencing God's power and receiving His promises. Jesus teaches that faith in God and belief in Him make all things possible and are essential for salvation, as seen in John 3:16 and Mark 9:23. Believing is not merely intellectual assent but a trust that leads to receiving what is prayed for, highlighting the intimate connection between faith and God's work in our lives as shown in Mark 11:22-24 and John 6:29.
